alt: Skin anatomy in cross-section (Blausen). Three layers - epidermis (stratified squamous keratinized), dermis (papillary + reticular layers with vessels, nerves, hair follicles, glands), hypodermis (subcutaneous fat). Accessory structures: hair shaft + follicle, sebaceous gland, sweat gland, arrector pili muscle. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
